title: On the continuity of the Tukey depth function for fuzzy data
summary: The practical use of statistical depth for fuzzy data requires regularity, inferential stability, and computational feasibility. This paper studies these aspects for the first time for the fuzzy depth, in particular for the fuzzy Tukey depth. In particular, we investigate the continuity of this depth with respect to each of its arguments. As a function of the elements of the underlying space, we prove its upper semicontinuity under the main metrics used in fuzzy spaces.
